card.name: Numbers in dosing and contraception durations
card.fires_on: Digits and time units inside a numeric duration or schedule, such as the 0 in Week 10, or 'months' after a number in contraception-after-last-dose advice.

modes.label: Months after last dose
modes.description: The unit 'months' right after a number in contraception advice following treatment.
modes.example: use effective contraception during treatment with DATROWAY and for 7<< months>> after the last dose.

modes.label: Digits in schedules or limits
modes.description: A digit completing a week number or a numeric threshold in a dosing schedule or hold rule.
modes.example: ister 320 mg by subcutaneous injection at Week 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 1<<0>>, 12, 14

modes.label: Time units in follow-up
modes.description: A time unit such as weeks after a number in monitoring schedules.
modes.example: then every 6<< weeks>> for the second year, and every
